headline: MIA @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.96 at TOR 3.88, with a projected total of 7.84. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: MIA moved -0.49 runs while TOR moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by -0.35 runs. The projected total fell -0.63, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Braydon Fisher has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Xavier Edwards, Ernie Clement, Jesús Sánchez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Kazuma Okamoto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
